discourse.title: Three in one
discourse.excerpt: The most effective cure for this illness is spiritual sadhana and progress, which can restore the genuine virtues of humanity.
discourse.theme: A world sick with hatred and stratagem is cured by spiritual sadhana — by understanding oneself and working with others for the good of all.

reflection: Swami diagnoses the world's illness — political stratagems, atheistic anarchy, declining respect for Truth — and prescribes sadhana that restores genuine human virtues. Today, practise one virtue deliberately: understand one person you disagree with before answering them, and work with someone for a common good. (Sri Sathya Sai Speaks, Vol 15, 1 Dec 1982)

seva_nudge: Begin December with one deliberate act of good character — keep a promise that is easy to break, or do one good deed quietly with no one watching.
